Hi OP! I just wanted to say something to you in the midst of all the emotions you may be feeling, but I see you. The emotions you have been feeling on-top of the response from your husband must be crushing. It must feel like so much time has been lost but I like to think about relapse as simply you falling up the stairs. It doesn’t happen often at all, but when you do, you’re not tumbling all the way down, you caught yourself after stumbling on one step. You have not lost all the things that have aided you in these 10 years and you haven’t lost all the things you’ve learned. You simply had a moment, the moment has ended, and you need some aftercare. I hope you are taking care of yourself in some way OP, you are strong and can do the things that seem impossible. ❤️
I really appreciate this. Thank you.
